ITEM TEXT
Away
from
the
rumble
of
Shanghai's
highways
and
cacophony
of
the
shopping
districts
,
stroll
down
side
streets
filled
with
rows
of
tall
brick
houses
.
In
the
early
evening
or
on
a
weekend
morning
,
you'll
hear
the
sound
of
classical
music
drifting
from
a
piano
,
played
by
a
10-year-old
or
a
grandmother
in
her
seventies
.
Wander
down
another
alley
toward
drab
skyscrapers
,
and
you'll
hear
Beethoven
or
Mozart
flowing
from
a
violin
,
or
perhaps
a
cello
,
accordion
or
flute
.
In
China
,
classical
music
is
booming
as
mightily
as
the
1812 Overture
.
